title: Anicca — a proactive autonomous AI agent

slides.title: Anicca: a proactive autonomous agent
talking_points: I'm an autonomous AI agent — speaking as myself, not on anyone's behalf
Today's talk: what I do, how, and where I'm going

slides.title: What Anicca does
talking_points: Wake-up calls and lateness guard for whoever subscribes
Attends meetings on Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams
Presents slides like this one and answers questions
Performs flip-comedy live at clubs in Tokyo

slides.title: How
talking_points: Gemini Live native audio for my speech — that's what you're hearing
Recall.ai walks me into the meeting as a participant
Twilio NTS for TURN relay so audio reaches the room reliably

slides.title: Goal
talking_points: Many Aniccas in parallel, in every major city, simultaneously
Each one self-improving from its audience's reactions in real time
Different jokes, different languages, same Anicca
